Because of the way it was presented, because of the way Anita sang, because of the way I wrote for her, because of our combined efforts at having something to say is why I think it was an artistic success. I think this is true of any collaborative exercise. When you really stop to think about it, there's nothing we can do in this world that doesn't have to be done with somebody.
